preconditions.description: The number of commands N must be between 1 and 1000.
Each command must have a length of at most 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(command.startswith('Simon says') or not command.startswith('Simon')) for command in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command either starts with 'Simon says' or does not start with 'Simon'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(command[11:] + '\n' for command in commands if command.startswith('Simon says'))
postconditions.description: The output must consist of the rest of the commands that start with 'Simon says', each followed by a newline.
